entries.title: Exodus 20:1
segments: ¶And God spake all these words, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 20:2
segments: I [am] the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. {bondage: Heb. servants}

entries.title: Exodus 20:3
segments: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

entries.title: Exodus 20:4
segments: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness [of any thing] that [is] in heaven above, or that [is] in the earth beneath, or that [is] in the water under the earth:

words.text: beneath, or that [is] in the water

entries.title: Exodus 20:5
segments: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God [am] a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth [generation] of them that hate me;

entries.title: Exodus 20:6
segments: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

entries.title: Exodus 20:7
segments: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

entries.title: Exodus 20:8
segments: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

entries.title: Exodus 20:9
segments: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

entries.title: Exodus 20:10
segments: But the seventh day [is] the sabbath of the LORD thy God: [in it] thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that [is] within thy gates:

entries.title: Exodus 20:11
segments: For [in] six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them [is], and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

words.text: , and all that in them [is], and rested

entries.title: Exodus 20:12
segments: ¶Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

entries.title: Exodus 20:13
segments: Thou shalt not kill.

entries.title: Exodus 20:14
segments: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

entries.title: Exodus 20:15
segments: Thou shalt not steal.

entries.title: Exodus 20:16
segments: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

entries.title: Exodus 20:17
segments: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that [is] thy neighbour's.

words.text: , nor any thing that [is] thy neighbour's

entries.title: Exodus 20:18
segments: ¶And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw [it], they removed, and stood afar off.

entries.title: Exodus 20:19
segments: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

words.text: thou with us, and we will hear

entries.title: Exodus 20:20
segments: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

entries.title: Exodus 20:21
segments: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God [was].

entries.title: Exodus 20:22
segments: ¶And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

entries.title: Exodus 20:23
segments: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

entries.title: Exodus 20:24
segments: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

words.text: unto thee, and I will bless

entries.title: Exodus 20:25
segments: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it. {build...: Heb. build them with hewing}

words.text: it. {build...: Heb. build them with hewing}

entries.title: Exodus 20:26
segments: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
